Credits & data

Publication Studio reads public records from ORCID and publication metadata from Crossref. It is an independent, non-commercial prototype.

BibTeX import uses Citation.js, by Lars Willighagen. MIT license.

References are rendered with citeproc-js. License.

The unmodified APA Style 7th edition CSL style is by Brenton M. Wiernik and Andrew Dunning, with contributions from Jay Pfaffman, distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0. Style and locale attribution are preserved in the distributed XML files.
